<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Sara Shbeeb | سارة شبيب</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Jost:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Wil;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,);font-display:swap;unicode-range:U+20-2F,U+3A-7E,U+A0-FF}
@font-face{font-family:Rill;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,);font-display:swap;unicode-range:U+20-2F,U+3A-7E,U+A0-FF}
@font-face{font-family:Bar;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,);font-display:swap;unicode-range:U+600-6FF,U+750-77F,U+FB50-FDFF,U+FE70-FEFF,U+200C-200F}
:root{--bg:#F7F1E5;--bg2:#E8DECE;--ink:#3A2A2F;--mute:#715459;--ac:#B98E62;--line:rgba(58,42,47,.2);--wine:#B98E62;--rose:#C9A59B;--sil:#E8DECE;--on:#2B2024;--glow:rgba(255,255,255,.7);--glow2:rgba(201,165,155,.25);box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#2B2024;--bg2:#3A2A2F;--ink:#F7F1E5;--mute:#DCCFC4;--ac:#B98E62;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.16);--glow:rgba(201,165,155,.16);--glow2:rgba(201,165,155,.3)}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#2B2024;--bg2:#3A2A2F;--ink:#F7F1E5;--mute:#DCCFC4;--ac:#B98E62;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.16);--glow:rgba(201,165,155,.16);--glow2:rgba(201,165,155,.3)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
html[lang=ar] .en,html[lang=en] .ar{display:none}
body{font-family:Bar,Jost,Tahoma,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.9;overflow-x:hidden;font-size:1.08rem}
html[lang=en] body{font-family:Jost,system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:300;line-height:1.7}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Bar,Jost,sans-serif;font-weight:400;line-height:1.25}
